description: The support desk demo conversation, posted by a test customer in the customer channel. Each step names what the fleet should do with it.

steps.text: Our webhook deliveries started failing this morning. Every POST to our endpoint is rejected with a signature mismatch, and nothing changed on our side.
steps.expect: intake opens a bug issue and posts its card in triage; copilot posts a draft card that cites docs pages or team articles, if any apply

steps.text: More detail: it is the order.created events, and clicking Redeliver gives the same mismatch.
steps.expect: intake links the reply to the bug issue (no new issue); copilot supersedes its draft with a new one

steps.text: URGENT: production is down for us. Every API call has returned 500 for the last 10 minutes and our checkout is blocked.
steps.expect: intake opens an urgent issue; urgent-pager (once added) DMs on-call

steps.text: Quick question: how do I deploy my agent project, and where do I see the first run once it is live?
steps.expect: intake opens a question issue; copilot selects the docs deploy page, fetches it live, and drafts an answer citing it
no new issue: Jev reads it as a thank-you
